crossRepositoryPathAliasCounterexamples.meaning: Identical relative path across independent Git roots does not establish semantic identity or currentness; different bytes disprove byte equivalence only.

proposedNamePolicy: PROPOSED_NAVIGATION_NAME = <exact Git repo>::<existing classified source region>/<source section>. This is NOT a changed physical path, owner authority, LEGO identity or public interface.

researchLocalVsRuntimeCut.notProvenEquivalent: Different Git cuts and dirty Runtime Workspace; no automatic data transfer or ancestry/final Writer inference.

importantScopeUnknowns: Workspace list excludes closed or unmanaged workspace objects and does not enumerate external providers, processes, credentials, physical service installs or dynamic consumers.
An open Windows or Linux Workspace is a source/workspace fact; it is not a deployed release, proof certificate or unique semantic LEGO.
Dirty workspace evidence must be preserved for independent decision; no repair, writer switch, source move or cleanup was performed.

windows.sourceRootClassification: Windows service/workspace source locator only; path obscured in published census; no proof it matches Linux/main or any installed executable

samplingAndExclusion.includeOnlyPaths: Exact git ls-tree blobs at pinned commit per repo; staged/untracked and installed/dynamic sources excluded
samplingAndExclusion.independentExternalSources: Only currently visible local roots with Ordivon prefix + active Research Runtime cut. Unmanaged Windows/remote/installed/disconnected Git roots remain UNKNOWN.
samplingAndExclusion.sourceRoleHints: Known directory/file-format hints only; all unknown or mixed roles retained rather than coerced into executable LEGO.

sourceCutPolicy: main observed 178079203fa545bd16f58fb22e3f646141d1522a; 7 sibling sources pinned to their locally observed exact HEAD; Research v2 pinned active Runtime Workspace cut fcef6d7...
sourceRoleVocabulary: PATH_ROLE_HINT labels derived from known directory segments (or explicitly bounded cross-system area), and observed file format. Labeling authorities, observations, consumer profiles, proof source, contracts or policy DOES NOT certify their truth, execution, authority, consumer graph or validation status.
